name: toseftasite
description: Digital edition viewer for the Tosefta: text, variants, synopsis and manuscript images.
comment: Local tooling only: this site has no build step and GitHub Pages serves the repo as-is. Deliberately NO dependencies block -- a file:../midrash-viewer-core path does not exist inside the repo, and any host that installs dependencies on finding a package.json would fail on it. sync:core reaches the sibling checkout by path and never resolves it through node_modules.
